note: Game units. Relative sizes follow the KPMG (2025) typical data-centre types, but absolute values are gameplay assumptions, not Bournemouth measurements.

buildings.name: Enterprise data centre
buildings.description: A single company's server hall. Small, quiet and cheap, but adds little compute.

buildings.name: Colocation data centre
buildings.description: Rents space to many clients. A solid step up in compute, water and noise.

buildings.name: Hyperscale campus
buildings.description: A cloud giant's campus. Enormous compute and income, and enormous demands on the town.

buildings.name: Solar farm
buildings.description: Adds local renewable electricity capacity on open land.

buildings.name: Offshore wind array
buildings.description: Large renewable supply built out in Poole Bay. Expensive, but keeps land free.

upgrades.name: Renewable power deal
upgrades.summary: Halves this centre's draw on the grid.

upgrades.name: Waste heat to homes
upgrades.survey_option: Redirected waste heat to warm local homes and businesses
upgrades.summary: Pipes server heat into nearby homes.

upgrades.name: Local jobs guarantee
upgrades.survey_option: Required to create a minimum number of local jobs
upgrades.summary: Commits to a minimum number of local hires.

upgrades.name: Community fund
upgrades.survey_option: Required to fund local community projects or amenities
